primary_thesis: Given a captured real-site representation, a real robot task, and multiple candidate robot policies, Blueprint can predict a useful ordering of those policies substantially faster and more cheaply than exhaustively evaluating every policy physically, while abstaining when its prediction is not trustworthy.

frozen_benchmark_calibration.basis: The 49-cluster heldout causal-conditioning diagnostic was powered for the registered 0.05 margin, but the overlay-masked scene residual had mean excess 0.039976, 95% CI [0.012196, 0.067883], p=0.762824 against the useful margin, and Wilson-lower validity pass rate 0.388648 versus the required 0.8. All causal gates failed. The heldout GPT-5 ranking matrix closed at 43/686 and was not scored.

captured_site_transfer.basis: InteriorGS was historically ingested and executed, but under a different OpenPI/MuJoCo stack. No frozen WAM/evaluator transfer, useful total ordering, calibrated abstention correctness, or site-specific physical accuracy was demonstrated.

overall_decision_rule: A sufficiently powered heldout failure of causal action signal or captured transfer yields thesis_not_supported. Both registered components are not_supported. Incomplete rank-fidelity and economic measurements are retained as unmeasured and do not erase direct falsification of necessary thesis conditions.

confidence_and_power.reason: The registered causal gate failed with development-estimated sensitivity finer than the useful margin, but rank fidelity and site-specific physical outcomes remain unmeasured.

successor_model.reason: New evaluator arms require a disjoint heldout split or new benchmark snapshot.

unresolved_limitations: The heldout GPT-5 ranking matrix is incomplete and no heldout ranking metric, confidence interval, or risk/coverage curve exists.
The causal diagnostic is a falsification test based on 2D pixel/action temporal alignment, not counterfactual WAM regeneration or 3D task success.
Captured-site evidence used a different stack and lacks site-specific physical labels.
Physical monetary cost and full physical wall-clock duration are unmeasured.
A broad metadata search and one precompletion canary inspection prevent a claim of pristine procedural blinding.
scope: This verdict applies to the frozen OSCAR representation/evaluator, released DROID-compatible policy cohort, registered causal test, and retained InteriorGS evidence. It is not a universal impossibility claim for future models, WAMs, tasks, or newly collected disjoint benchmarks.
